audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications on Windows, Linux, or macOS who need programmatic Excel workbook manipulation without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format using Workbook.Save().
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve cell values of multiple types including strings, numbers, booleans, and DateTime, and manage Excel formulas via Cell.PutValue() and Cell.SetFormula().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify cell appearance using Style objects that bundle Font, Borders, FillPattern, foreground/background colors, alignment, and text wrap.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styling

capabilities.text: Control visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, and apply worksheet protection settings directly on Worksheet.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet view and protection

capabilities.text: Define rule-driven formatting via FormatCondition and enforce input constraints using Validation, both scoped to CellArea ranges.
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting and data validation

capabilities.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, scaling, print area, headers/footers, and page breaks using PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Configure page setup and print settings

capabilities.text: Attach hyperlinks to cell ranges and define workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges with optional comments.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and defined names

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended metadata through WorkbookProperties and DocumentProperties exposed on Workbook.
capabilities.title: Access document properties

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for load and save; saving to other formats throws UnsupportedFeatureException.
Legacy SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) is not implemented; mapper classes unconditionally throw UnsupportedFeatureException.
Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName has a Comment field.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are dropped with a WarningInfo during load instead of preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.
Prebuilt binaries are available only for Windows using MSVC v14x toolset; other platforms require building from source.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation, reading, and writing in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or COM interop.
Provides a familiar API surface compatible with Aspose.Cells commercial products for teams migrating from or extending existing workflows.
Supports cross-platform development with a header-and-source C++17 library that has no external runtime dependencies.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, MIT-licensed C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported AutoFilter patterns and which date-group filters are rejected is not detailed beyond the general statement.
Whether the library supports reading or writing .xlsb, .xls, .ods, or .csv formats is implied to be unsupported but not explicitly confirmed beyond .xlsx.
The behavior when loading malformed but structurally plausible .xlsx files is not detailed beyond InvalidFileFormatException.
The extent of locale-specific formatting support in DisplayTextFormatter beyond the presence of locale-related symbols is unclear.
Whether the library supports embedded charts, pivot tables, or macros is not stated in the fact dossier.
The exact set of formula functions supported in Cell.SetFormula() is not listed.
The behavior of Workbook.Save() when the target path is unwritable is not specified beyond WorkbookSaveException.
Whether the library supports reading or writing OLE objects or embedded files within the .xlsx package is not stated.

workflows.name: Create and style a workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access its first Worksheet, populate cells with values and formulas, apply header styling using Style and Font, and save to an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Load and inspect an existing workbook
workflows.text: Construct a Workbook from a file path or in-memory std::vector<std::uint8_t> stream, then read cell values, formulas, and metadata.

workflows.name: Apply conditional formatting and validation
workflows.text: Use ConditionalFormattingCollection and ValidationCollection on a Worksheet to define rule-driven formatting and input constraints over CellArea ranges.

workflows.name: Configure page setup and print options
workflows.text: Access PageSetup via Worksheet to set paper size, orientation, margins, print area, headers/footers, and page breaks.

workflows.name: Manage hyperlinks and defined names
workflows.text: Attach hyperlinks to cell ranges using HyperlinkCollection and define workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges via DefinedNameCollection.

workflows.name: Run the test suite
workflows.text: Build and execute the GTest-based test suite from Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp.Tests using CMake, optionally using a system-installed GoogleTest.
